title: Google Workspace Plugins
description: Google Workspace Plugins now give coding agents direct access to Gmail, Google Drive, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, and Google Chat.

title: Cursor for iPad Released
description: Cursor expanded its multi-platform availability with the release of Cursor for iPad, bringing AI-powered coding to tablet devices. Includes inbox feature and full PR review experience with comments, checks, and approvals.

title: v0.146.0: Session Management and Plugin Enhancements
description: Added session naming with /new and /clear commands, thread pinning, side conversation switching, Agent Plugins manifests support, WebSocket connections for Code Mode, and improved Windows compatibility including terminal responsiveness.

title: Cursor Start Feature Launch
description: Cursor introduced Start, a new ₹649 monthly plan for developers in India with local pricing and UPI payment options.

title: v0.53.0: LLM Triage Orchestrator and Security Enhancements
description: Implemented LLM triage orchestrator, container build setup, evaluation coverage report generation, workspace trust enforcement, and task isolation. Fixed infinite ReAct/prompt injection loops and other security issues.

title: Updated Data Training Policy
description: GitHub now uses interactions from Copilot Free, Pro, and Pro+ subscribers to train and improve AI models unless users opt out. The policy includes inputs, outputs, code snippets, and associated context.

title: Cursor Router Released
description: Cursor launched Router, an intelligent model router that analyzes each request and sends it to the right model with three optimization modes: Intelligence, Balance, and Cost. Available across desktop, web, iOS, CLI, and SDK.

title: v0.145.0: Paginated History and Import Features
description: Experimental paginated thread history with efficient resume and search, /import functionality to migrate settings from Cursor and Claude Code, Amazon Bedrock login support, audio inputs, and stabilized multi-agent V2 experience.
